hook: Cyberabad asks *3.5 lakh* students for ideas to fix traffic
hook_b: Cyberabad asks *3.5 lakh* students for ideas to fix traffic
tldr: Cyberabad Police and Cyberabad Municipal Corporation are inviting students to Cyberabad Moves 2026 and its Innovation Challenge on congestion and road safety.

beats.what: Police Commissioner M Ramesh and CMC Commissioner G Srijana briefed schools and colleges in a virtual session on Nov 17.
beats.why: The programme links classroom subjects like geography, maths and civics with real commuting problems.
beats.care: Interactive activities for students run at T-Hub from November 26 to 28.

causes.label: Congestion and road safety in Cyberabad
